---
title: "GRC greenOlive"
subtitle: "Guide to everything the theme can do"
author: "Gabriela Romero Campos"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  grcthemes::GRC_greenOlive:
    code_folding: show        # show | hide | none
    # --- every option, with its default -----------------------------------
    # intro_label: "Overview"   # side-menu label for text before the first ##
    # self_notes: true          # false = remove all "::: self" boxes (version to share)
    # footer_author: "Gabriela Romero Campos"   # "" = only the update time
    # logo_chip: true           # false = white logos directly on the header
    # logos: "C:/my/logos"     # folder with logo_* files, or ["a.png", "b.png"]; [] = none
    # header_img: "img/bg.png"  # background image behind the title
    # footer_img: "img/ft.png"  # background image behind the footer text
    # ggplot_defaults: true     # false = do not apply the theme to ggplots
    # download_dpi: 300         # camera button resolution; null = no buttons
    # highlight: "tango"        # code colours
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(grcthemes)   # greenOlive_colors(), scale_*_greenOlive(), grc_gallery(), ...
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5)

# demo data used in this guide
set.seed(42)
sites <- paste("Site", LETTERS[1:5])
ndvi  <- expand.grid(site = sites, day = seq(0, 120, by = 10))
ndvi$ndvi <- 0.2 + 0.6 * exp(-((ndvi$day - c(70, 75, 80, 65, 85)[match(ndvi$site, sites)]) / 35)^2) +
  rnorm(nrow(ndvi), 0, 0.02)
plots <- data.frame(site  = rep(sites, each = 30),
                    yield = rnorm(150, rep(c(4.2, 4.8, 5.1, 3.9, 4.5), each = 30), 0.5))
```

# Start here

This document is both a **demo** and a **cheat sheet**: every page shows a
feature working and, right below, how to write it. Create it again any time
from RStudio: *File > New File > R Markdown > From Template > GRC greenOlive - guide*.

Text written between a `#` heading and its first `##` (like this paragraph)
becomes the first side-menu item, labelled **Overview** (`intro_label`).

## Page structure

The headings build the menus:

| You write | It becomes |
|---|---|
| `# Data` | a tab in the **main menu** (top bar) |
| `## Flights` | an item in the **side menu** of that tab; only one `##` page is shown at a time |
| `### Details` and below | headings inside the current page |
| text before the first `##` | side-menu item "Overview" |
| a `#` with no `##` | a single page, the side menu is hidden |

```markdown
# Data

Short introduction (side-menu item "Overview").

## Flights
...
### Sensor settings
...
## Orthomosaics
...
```

**Links between pages** work with the heading id (lower case, spaces become
`-`): `[see the callouts](#callouts)` gives [see the callouts](#callouts).
Custom ids: `## My page {#my-id}`. Back/forward buttons and reloading the page
keep the current position.

## YAML options

Everything is optional. The YAML at the top of this file lists every option
with its default value (commented out).

```yaml
output:
  grcthemes::GRC_greenOlive:
    code_folding: hide
    self_notes: false
    download_dpi: 600
```

Inside a chunk, `grc_themes()` lists the themes installed:
`r paste(grc_themes(), collapse = ", ")`.

# Text

## Formatting

Body text is set in Lato. **Bold**, *italic*, `inline code`,
[external link](https://www.k-state.edu), footnote[^1], subscript H~2~O,
superscript m^2^, and maths: $NDVI = \frac{NIR - Red}{NIR + Red}$.

[^1]: Footnotes go to the end of the page.

> Quotes use the accent font (Libre Baskerville italic): good for a key
> finding or a definition.

1. Numbered list
2. Second item
   - nested bullet

```markdown
**Bold**, *italic*, `inline code`, [link](https://...), footnote[^1]
H~2~O, m^2^, $NDVI = \frac{NIR - Red}{NIR + Red}$

[^1]: Footnote text.

> A quote in the accent font.
```

Inline R results: the data have `r nrow(plots)` plots, mean yield
`r round(mean(plots$yield), 2)` t/ha, written as `` `r knitr::inline_expr("round(mean(plots$yield), 2)")` ``.

## Callouts

::: note
**Note** (importance 3): general remarks.
:::

::: self
**Note to self**: reminders such as "do not run X because of Y".
Removed from the HTML with `self_notes: false` in the YAML.
:::

::: attention
**Attention** (importance 1): things the reader must not miss.
:::

::: {.attention title="Sensor firmware changed"}
Any box takes a custom title. Lists, `code` and **bold** work inside.
:::

```markdown
::: note
General note.
:::

::: self
Do not run normalize() with method = "panel": no panel in 2023.
:::

::: attention
Sites D and E used another firmware.
:::

::: {.attention title="Custom title"}
Text.
:::
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(aggregate(yield ~ site, plots, function(x) round(mean(x), 2)),
             caption = "Mean yield by site (t/ha).", align = "lr")
```

# Code

## Code folding

With `code_folding: show` (or `hide`) in the YAML, every chunk gets a
**Show code / Hide code** button, and the top bar gets **Show/Hide all code**.

```{r}
# a normal chunk: follows the YAML default
summary(plots$yield)
```

```{r, class.source = "fold-hide"}
# this one starts collapsed even with code_folding: show
quantile(plots$yield, c(0.05, 0.95))
```

````markdown
```{r, class.source = "fold-hide"}   # starts collapsed
```
```{r, class.source = "fold-show"}   # starts open (with code_folding: hide)
```
```{r, echo = FALSE}                 # no code at all, only the output
```
````

## Chunk options

| Option | Effect |
|---|---|
| `echo = FALSE` | hide the code, show the output |
| `include = FALSE` | run, show nothing (setup, data loading) |
| `eval = FALSE` | show the code, do not run it |
| `message = FALSE`, `warning = FALSE` | hide messages / warnings |
| `fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5` | figure size (inches) |
| `fig.cap = "..."` | figure caption (one per plot in galleries) |
| `class.source = "fold-hide"` | start with the code collapsed |
| `gallery = TRUE` | put all plots of the chunk in a gallery |
| `download = FALSE` | no camera (download) button for these plots |

# Figures

## Figures and download

ggplots get the theme and colours **automatically** (no `theme_*()` needed).
Hover the figure: the **camera** button downloads a 300 dpi PNG
(`download_dpi` in the YAML); the file is named after the chunk label.

```{r ndvi-season, fig.cap = "NDVI over the season (simulated)."}
ggplot(ndvi, aes(day, ndvi, colour = site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "NDVI over the season", subtitle = "Five sites",
       x = "Days after sowing", y = "NDVI", colour = NULL,
       caption = "Captions inside the plot use the accent font.")
```

```{r, download = FALSE, fig.height = 3.5}
# download = FALSE: no camera button (smaller HTML)
ggplot(plots, aes(site, yield, fill = site)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(title = "Yield by site", x = NULL, y = "Yield (t/ha)")
```

::: note
Each downloadable figure adds about 200 KB to the HTML. For reports with many
figures, use `download = FALSE` in some chunks or `download_dpi: null` in the YAML.
:::

## Colours and scales

```{r, fig.height = 2.6}
greenOlive_colors()      # the 8 categorical colours, with names
pal <- greenOlive_colors()
ggplot(data.frame(name = factor(names(pal), names(pal))), aes(name, 1, fill = name)) +
  geom_col() + guides(fill = "none") + theme_greenOlive(grid = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.8}
grid <- expand.grid(x = 1:40, y = 1:20)
grid$ndvi <- with(grid, 0.3 + 0.5 * exp(-((x - 25)^2 + (y - 10)^2) / 120))
grid$diff <- with(grid, 0.08 * sin(x / 6) + 0.05 * cos(y / 4))

ggplot(grid, aes(x, y, fill = diff)) + geom_raster() + coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_greenOlive_c("div", midpoint = 0) +      # diverging
  theme_greenOlive(grid = "none") +
  labs(title = "Diverging scale", subtitle = "e.g. flight 2 - flight 1", x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

| Function | Use |
|---|---|
| `greenOlive_colors(3)` / `greenOlive_colors("olive", "peach")` | hex codes by number or name |
| `scale_colour_greenOlive()` / `scale_fill_greenOlive()` | groups (default; up to 8); `reverse = TRUE` |
| `scale_fill_greenOlive_c("seq")` | continuous, cream to olive (default; e.g. NDVI) |
| `scale_fill_greenOlive_c("div", midpoint = 0)` | diverging, blue - cream - terracotta |
| `theme_greenOlive(grid = "y", legend = "right")` | the theme; `grid`: `"xy"`, `"y"`, `"x"`, `"none"` |

Names: olive, peach, sand, blue, plum, rose, dark, grey. More than 8 groups:
prefer `facet_wrap()`.

## Base R plots

Base graphics also get the cream background; use the theme colours by hand:

```{r, fig.height = 3.5}
hist(plots$yield, col = greenOlive_colors("sand"), border = "white",
     main = "Yield", xlab = "t/ha")
```

## Gallery

Many similar plots: one big selected image + thumbnails (click, arrows, or
the keyboard ← →). The camera button downloads the selected image.

**1. Plots made in the chunk:** `gallery = TRUE` (remember `print()` inside loops).

```{r, gallery = TRUE, fig.cap = paste("NDVI curve,", sites)}
for (s in sites) {
  print(
    ggplot(subset(ndvi, site == s), aes(day, ndvi)) +
      geom_area(fill = greenOlive_colors("sand"), alpha = .6) +
      geom_line(colour = greenOlive_colors("olive"), linewidth = 1.2) +
      ylim(0, 1) + labs(title = s, x = "Days after sowing", y = "NDVI")
  )
}
```

**2. Images already saved:** `grc_gallery(files, captions)`; captions default
to the file names.

```{r, include = FALSE}
# (only for this demo: save a few PNGs in a temporary folder)
demo_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "gallery demo")
dir.create(demo_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (s in sites[1:3]) {
  ggsave(file.path(demo_dir, paste0("yield_", s, ".png")),
         ggplot(subset(plots, site == s), aes(yield)) +
           geom_histogram(bins = 12, fill = greenOlive_colors("blue"), colour = "white") +
           labs(title = paste("Yield -", s), x = "t/ha", y = "Plots") + theme_greenOlive(),
         width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 150, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "#FFFCF6")
}
```

```{r}
grc_gallery(list.files(demo_dir, pattern = "png$", full.names = TRUE))
```

**3. Markdown block** around images or chunks:

```markdown
::: gallery
![Caption 1](figs/a.png)

![Caption 2](figs/b.png)
:::
```

## Interactive

htmlwidgets such as plotly work normally, also on pages that start hidden.

```{r, eval = requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)}
plotly::plot_ly(ndvi, x = ~day, y = ~ndvi, color = ~site,
                colors = greenOlive_colors(5), type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers")
```

# Help

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Plot fonts look plain in the RStudio Plots pane | *Tools > Global Options > General > Graphics > Backend: AGG* (inside the report it already works) |
| Page fonts missing after rendering | the HTML downloads Google Fonts at render time: knit with internet |
| Plots from a loop do not appear | wrap them in `print()` |
| HTML file too big | `download = FALSE` in some chunks, or `download_dpi: null` |
| A `::: self` note appears in the shared version | render with `self_notes: false` |
| Heading link does not work | check the id: lower case, spaces as `-`, or set `{#my-id}` |

## Functions

| Function | |
|---|---|
| `GRC_greenOlive()` | the output format (`output: grcthemes::GRC_greenOlive`) |
| `grc_themes()` | themes installed |
| `grc_gallery(files, captions)` | gallery from image files |
| `greenOlive_colors()`, `greenOlive_palette` | colours |
| `scale_colour_greenOlive()`, `scale_fill_greenOlive()` | discrete scales |
| `scale_colour_greenOlive_c()`, `scale_fill_greenOlive_c()` | continuous scales (`"seq"`, `"div"`) |
| `theme_greenOlive()` | ggplot theme |

Help pages: `?GRC_greenOlive`, `?theme_greenOlive`, etc.
